title: Ordered interleaved model cost
statement:
Let $x$ assign a sign to each of nine coordinates. Choose three block indices $b_1,b_2,b_3\in\{0,1,2\}$ and three seed indices $s_1,s_2,s_3\in\{0,1,2\}$. Write $x_i$ for the input sign selected by $(b_i,s_i)$, $y_i$ for the block value of block $b_i$, $C_i$ for the completion cost at $(b_i,s_i)$, and $E_3$ for the evaluation cost at $(b_3,s_3)$. The cost is $2$ plus the following quantity: if $x_1=x_2$, it is $C_1+C_2$ when $y_1=x_1$ and $y_2=y_1$, is $C_1+E_3$ when $y_1=x_1$ and $y_2
e y_1$, is $C_1+E_3$ when $y_1
e x_1$ and $y_3=y_1$, and is $E_3+C_2$ otherwise; if $x_1
e x_2$, it is $E_3+C_1$ when $y_3=x_1$ and $y_1=y_3$, is $E_3+C_2$ when $y_3=x_1$ and $y_1
e y_3$, is $C_2$ when $y_3
e x_1$ and $y_2=y_3$, and is $C_2+C_1$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A sign assignment on nine coordinates
caveat: The recursive input, block-value, completion-cost, and evaluation-cost definitions are not supplied, so the auxiliary quantities can only be described by their roles.
